title: Hex isle
description: CC0 KayKit hex tiles form an island through a day. The glTF reader loads models and textures. A moving sun casts shadows and the sky passes through sunset and a blue hour to night. One instance kind spins windmills, drifts clouds lit in the colour of the sky and lights windows at dusk. Depth of field blurs above and below a band so the island looks like a miniature, or, set to the pointer, focuses on what is under it.
line: glTF hex tiles through a day, a tilt-shift miniature or in focus under the pointer.
hint: drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
